profile.summary: nbalduzzi is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Fastify plugin development and Node.js backend ecosystems. Their contributions focus on extending Fastify's functionality through plugins for database integration (Knex.js, MongoDB), testing support (mocking, in-memory databases), and API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI). The developer demonstrates strong skills in modular plugin architecture, documentation maintenance, and testing-friendly designs, with a clear focus on improving the Fastify developer experience. Their work reflects intermediate to advanced proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and the Node.js plugin ecosystem.
